gates.locked_prompt: Barred from the Queen-Comb Sanctuary side

pickups.label: Claim the First Comb Reliquary Coffer

plaques.text:
CLOISTER OF THE GOLDEN COMB

Above the smoke of the kettles, the Sisters of the Skep tended the living hives in open noon. Look not into an unsealed skep without a veil; the bees gather the hour before it cools.

THE FOUR SANCTUM VOTIVES

Two flames are kept by the press-masters of the West Cellar; two by the scribes of the East Chapter-House. Only when all four burn together does the Queen-Comb Sanctuary unbar.

THE ROYAL SCREW-PRESSES

Seven turns of the bronze spindle press the summer out of the comb. What runs clear ischrism for the lamps; what remains in the cake is harder than church-iron.

THE SOVEREIGN COMB-BLADE

Forged for the First Abbess of the Apiary, its fuller is hollowed into seven hexagonal cells of royal wax. Whoever bears it carries the warmth of the cliff-gardens into the dark.

VOW OF MATRIARCH AURELIA

They have taken the bells, the choir, and the six lower vats. They shall not have the Queen-Skep. I have drunk the boiling comb myself and barred the nave; let the Palace come and harvest it from my bones.
